theorem all_106_signed_count_bases {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (root : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N root →
      ∀ g : Fin 430,
        (∑ a : Original106Action, ∑ l∈selectedLevel N n root t p g a,
          levelMark l*physicalDefect l) + selectedBankRoundingLoss N n root t p g ≤
        (∑ a : Original106Action, ∑ l∈selectedLevel N n root t p g a,
          levelMark l*debt N (rootQ N n root t p) (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l) g a) +
          ε*actualBankTheta N n root t p g

terminal_statements.name: ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalH430SeedFourMarkedRounds.four_physical_round_count_debts
terminal_statements.full_statement:
theorem four_physical_round_count_debts {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ r : Fin 4,let Q := rootQ N n k t p
        let B := seedPositions N n k t p
        let D := B.image wordProduct
        let σ := groupedSigma B wordProduct levelMark
        5*((∑ l∈B,levelMark l*trueAt l)-(1-originalRound r.succ)*markedTheta B) ≤
          signedAnchors N Q D σ+signedSingles N Q D σ+signedPositive N Q D σ+
          5*originalRound r.castSucc*(∑ l∈B,levelMark l*physicalFeedback N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l))+
          ε*markedTheta B

terminal_statements.name: ImbalancedChen.Part5OriginalH430W1SignedOrdinaryBase.selected_W1_signed_base
terminal_statements.full_statement:
theorem selected_W1_signed_base {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ, 4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ (g : Fin 430) (i : Fin 7) (j : Fin 10), let S := selectedLevel N n k t p g (.inl (i,j))
      let Q := rootQ N n k t p
      (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*(trueAt l - thetaAtom N Q (wordProduct l) *
        (upperA (levelOccurrence l).current.node.physical.argument - baseValue (.inl (i,j)) -
          fixedValue (precedingH g) (.inl (i,j))-idealFeedbackValue (iterate g.val) (.inl (i,j))))) ≤
        (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*(fixedDebt N Q (wordProduct l) i j g +
          lowerDebt N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l) i j g/2 +
          switchedDebt N Q (wordProduct l) i j)) + ε*markedTheta S

terminal_statements.full_statement:
theorem all70_true_converted_base {η A ε : ℝ} (hη : 0<η) (hA : η≤A) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → ∀ (Q L : ℝ) (d : ℕ) (i : Fin 7) (j : Fin 10),
      L∈Icc η A → 0<d → Q=(d:ℝ)*(N:ℝ)^L → 2≤trueAlpha N Q d →
      switchedDebt N Q d i j ≤ primeDebt N Q d i j+ε*thetaAtom N Q d

theorem selected_W2_signed_base {ε : ℝ} (he : 0<ε) :
    ∃ T : ℕ,4≤T ∧ ∀ N : ℕ,T≤N → Even N → ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Root) (t : ℝ) (p : ℕ),
      0≤t → t≤1/12 → 1/((n:ℝ)+1)≤11/384 → p∈originalBand N k →
      ∀ (g : Fin 430) (j : Fin 36), let S := selectedLevel N n k t p g (.inr j)
      let Q := rootQ N n k t p
      (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*(trueAt l - thetaAtom N Q (wordProduct l) *
        (upperA (levelOccurrence l).current.node.physical.argument - baseValue (.inr j) -
          fixedValue (precedingH g) (.inr j)-idealFeedbackValue (iterate g.val) (.inr j)))) ≤
        (∑ l∈S,levelMark l*rowDebt N Q (wordLevel l) (wordProduct l) j g) + ε*markedTheta S
